title: 2x Tradescantia fluminensis 'Bicolor' Mini Plug Plant | Small-leaf Spiderwort
description:
This is a low-growing, clump-forming evergreen perennial. While it initially has an upright habit, it quickly changes to a trailing form, making it an excellent choice for hanging baskets or shelf edges. The foliage is smooth, pointed, and oval, characterized by a grey-green surface with distinctive grey-purple undersides.


 Small white flowers may appear throughout the year, though these are rarely produced when the plant is grown indoors.


  Plant Specifications:
 

   Supplied as:
  
  1x Mini Plug Plant
 

   Ultimate Height:
  
  0.1–0.5 metres
 

   Ultimate Spread:
  
  0.1–0.5 metres
 

   Time to Ultimate Height:
  
  1–2 years
 

   Foliage:
  
  Evergreen
 

   Family:
  
  Commelinaceae
 

  Growing Conditions & Care:
 

   Position:
  
  Partial shade. Suitable for North-facing, East-facing, or West-facing aspects.
 

   Soil:
  
  Loam or Sand based.
 

   Moisture:
  
  Well-drained.
 

   pH:
  
  Acid, Alkaline, or Neutral.
 

   Exposure:
  
  Needs a sheltered spot.
 

  Hardiness & Temperature:
 

   RHS Hardiness Rating:
  
  H1b
 

   Temperature Requirement:
  
  This plant requires temperatures between 10°C and 15°C.
 

   Usage:
  
  It is suitable for growing under glass all year or as a houseplant. It can be placed outside during the summer months but must be protected from low temperatures. It will not survive being frozen.
